title: Nourishing Flaky Portuguese Cheese Flatbread
description: A garlicky and flaky post-workout Portuguese dish featuring mature cheddar and shio-cure, served on a tagliere, high in protein to support muscle recovery.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, salt, and dried oregano.
Add the warm water, olive oil, and beaten egg to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough into a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spread the minced garlic evenly over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese and shio-cure over the garlic.
Fold the edges of the dough over the filling to form a crust.
Place the flatbread on a tagliere or large cutting board and bake for 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
